title: Can Agents Truly Forget? Explore Machine Unlearning for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.17659v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown strong capabilities in interactive problem solving, tool use, and long-horizon task execution. However, they may also acquire sensitive or private knowledge during training and expose it during deployment. Retraining a model from scratch to remove such knowledge is prohibitively costly, making machine unlearning a more practical approach. Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted undesirable knowledge from trained models without retraining from scratch while preserving general utility. When language models are deployed as agents, parameter-level unlearning becomes insufficient: forgotten information may still persist in memory artifacts or be reacquired via tool calls. In this paper, we formulate the problem of agent unlearning as removing private information from an LLM-based agent across three information channels: parametric knowledge, persistent memory, and tool-call acquisition. To study

translated_title: 智能体真的能遗忘吗？探索面向大语言模型智能体的机器遗忘
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在交互式问题求解、工具使用和长程任务执行方面展现出强大的能力。然而，它们在训练过程中也可能获取敏感或私密知识，并在部署时将其暴露。通过从头重新训练模型来删除此类知识的代价极其高昂，因此机器遗忘成为一种更实用的方法。机器遗忘旨在从已训练模型中删除特定的不良知识，而无需从头重新训练，同时保持模型的通用能力。当语言模型被部署为智能体时，仅进行参数层面的遗忘是不够的：被遗忘的信息可能仍持久存在于记忆工件中，或通过工具调用被重新获取。在本文中，我们将智能体遗忘问题形式化为从基于大语言模型的智能体中，跨三个信息渠道删除私密信息：参数化知识、持久记忆和工具调用获取。为了研究……
tldr: 该论文提出“智能体遗忘”新问题，指出仅靠参数级遗忘不足以让大语言模型智能体真正遗忘，必须同时覆盖参数知识、持久记忆和工具调用三个信息渠道来删除私密信息。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates the new problem of agent unlearning, showing that parameter-level forgetting is insufficient—private information must be removed across all three channels of parametric knowledge, persistent memory, and tool-call acquisition for LLM agents to truly forget.
